fah-175.title: Fava Beans with Cream & Nuts
fah-175.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-175.culturalNotes: You can serve the beans with roasted potatoes and ta'ameya. The beans keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat the ghee in a pot over the heat.
instructions.2: Add the nuts and toast them until golden.
instructions.3: Add the cooked fava beans and stir them well with the nuts.
instructions.4: Add a little water so the beans don't dry out and stay soft.
instructions.5: Leave the mixture to boil over the heat.
instructions.6: Add the black pepper and salt and stir well.
instructions.7: Add a spoonful of the cream (eshta) and stir well.
instructions.8: Leave it to boil for another minute.
instructions.9: Add the second spoonful of cream and stir well.
instructions.10: Pour into the tagine and serve hot.

fah-176.title: Fava Beans Four Ways (Mixed Seasonings)
fah-176.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-176.culturalNotes: Serve the beans with stuffed ta'ameya, ta'ameya with pickled lemon and een el-katkout. The beans keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat the oil in a frying pan and sauté the onion until golden.
instructions.2: Add the mixed-colour peppers and hot pepper and stir for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the cumin and salt and stir well.
instructions.4: Add a spoonful of the duqqa and stir for a minute.
instructions.5: Add the beans and stir for two minutes until heated through.
instructions.6: In a second pan, heat the ghee, add the stock cube and stir until golden.
instructions.7: Add the beans and stir for two minutes.
instructions.8: In a third pan, heat the oil, add the eggs and stir until softly set.
instructions.9: Add the beans and stir for two minutes.
instructions.10: In a fourth pan, heat the ghee, add the nuts and stir until golden.
instructions.11: Add the raisins, chilli and salt and stir well.
instructions.12: Add the beans and stir for two minutes.
instructions.13: Serve the beans with stuffed ta'ameya, ta'ameya with pickled lemon and een el-katkout.

fah-177.title: Kebab-Flavoured Fava Beans
fah-177.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-177.culturalNotes: You can add some chopped parsley as a garnish before serving. The beans keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Finely chop the onion, tomatoes and green pepper in the food processor.
instructions.2: Heat the oil in a pan over the heat.
instructions.3: Add the chopped onion and stir until lightly coloured.
instructions.4: Add the onion, tomato and green pepper mixture and stir well until it thickens.
instructions.5: Add the beans and a quarter cup of water and mash until the beans are smooth.
instructions.6: Add the salt, black pepper, cumin, coriander and chilli and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the mashed beans to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.8: Pour into a serving tagine and place it over low heat.
instructions.9: Add a small piece of charcoal and a drop of oil and cover the tagine.
instructions.11: Serve the beans hot with rocket (arugula) and pickles.

fah-178.title: Foul bel-Tawdeeb (Fava Beans with Seasoning Mixes)
fah-178.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-178.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for a long time without spoiling. You can serve the beans whichever way you prefer, mashed or whole.

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, wheat berries and split fava beans in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and put the ingredients in a large pot.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrot and cover with water until it covers the ingredients by about 6 cm.
instructions.4: Put the pot over high heat until the water boils, then lower the heat and leave until cooked through.
instructions.5: Add half a cup of rice flour and a tablespoon of turmeric and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the kahramani beans and stir well.
instructions.7: In another pan, add two tablespoons of ghee and brown the basturma and green pepper, then add the beans and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the salt and pepper, then put the mixture in a tagine and into the oven.
instructions.9: In another pan, add the oil, the minced onion and the minced garlic, then add the tomatoes, bell pepper, hot chilli and tomato paste and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the salt, cumin, coriander and chilli, then add the beans and stir well.
instructions.11: Make the sauce by mixing the tahini, vinegar, duqqa, boiling water and oil, then chill it in the fridge.
instructions.12: Put the beans in a blender and blitz them, then add the oil, cumin and salt and stir well.
instructions.13: Put the beans in a pan and stir over the heat with a pinch of cumin and salt, then add the sauce.
instructions.14: Put the beans in a pan with the yogurt and duqqa, then add the onion, pepper, tomatoes and parsley and stir well.
instructions.15: Drizzle the olive oil over the top.

fah-179.title: Foul bel-Duqqa (Fava Beans with Crushed Garlic & Cumin)
fah-179.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-179.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for a long time without spoiling. You can serve the beans with bread, cheese and olives.

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, wheat berries and split fava beans in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and put the beans in a large pot.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrot and boiling water until it covers the beans by about 6 centimetres.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and put it over high heat until the water boils.
instructions.5: Lower the heat and leave the beans to cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Add half a cup of rice flour, a tablespoon of turmeric and a cup of water, and stir well.
instructions.7: Leave the beans to cook for a further 10 minutes until the consistency is just right.
instructions.8: For the first seasoning mix: add two tablespoons of ghee, two pieces of basturma, the green pepper and the kahramani beans, and stir over the heat.
instructions.9: Add the salt and pepper, then put the mixture in a tagine, nestle the eggs in the middle of the beans and top with a spoon of ghee.
instructions.10: For the second seasoning mix: add a little oil, a spoonful of minced garlic and minced onion, and sauté over the heat.
instructions.11: Add the tomatoes, bell pepper, hot chilli and tomato paste and stir well.
instructions.12: Add the salt, cumin, coriander and chilli, then put the beans over the mixture and stir well.
instructions.13: For the sauce: mix the tahini, vinegar, duqqa, cumin, coriander, chilli and boiling water, then add the oil and stir well.
instructions.14: For the third seasoning mix: mix the beans with the oil, cumin and salt, then put the mixture in a pan and add the sauce.
instructions.15: For the fourth seasoning mix: mix the yogurt with the duqqa, garlic and pepper, then add the cooked beans and stir well.
instructions.16: Add the onion, tomatoes, hot chilli and parsley, then stir well.
instructions.17: Put the mixture in a pan and add the olive oil.

fah-180.title: Foul Mothabbash (Crushed Fava Beans)
fah-180.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-180.culturalNotes: You can add more spices to taste. The beans keep in the fridge for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Cut the bell pepper, onion, tomatoes and hot chilli into small pieces.
instructions.2: Add the garlic, hot and sweet peppers and fresh coriander to the food processor and crush them well.
instructions.3: Add the salt, black pepper, cumin and coriander to the mixture and crush again.
instructions.4: Add the vinegar to the mixture and crush well — this is the duqqa.
instructions.5: Heat a frying pan over the heat and add the chopped onion.
instructions.6: Once the onion has softened, add the tomatoes, bell pepper and hot chilli.
instructions.7: Add the cumin, coriander and salt to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.8: Add the beans to the mixture and stir together.
instructions.9: Add boiling water to the mixture and leave it to cook for 10 minutes.
instructions.10: Once the mixture is cooked, pour it into the serving dish.
instructions.11: Add the prepared duqqa and the tahini to the dish.
instructions.12: Serve the beans with baladi bread.

fah-181.title: Roasted Fava Beans (Foul Meshwi)
fah-181.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-181.culturalNotes: Never use a wet spoon or your hands when putting away the roasted beans — it keeps them fresh for longer.

instructions.1: Soak the termis and chickpeas in boiling water for 3 hours.
instructions.2: Drain the termis and chickpeas and wash them well.
instructions.3: Boil the termis and chickpeas in boiling water for an hour to an hour and a half.
instructions.4: Drain the fava beans and wash them well.
instructions.5: Roast the fava beans over medium heat until coloured.
instructions.6: Put the beans in a dish, pour over boiling water with two tablespoons of salt and leave until tender.
instructions.7: Make the duqqa: mix the water, salt, cumin, paprika, chilli and lemon juice in a bowl.
instructions.8: Add the termis, chickpeas and beans to the duqqa and submerge them completely.
instructions.9: Leave the mixture for two to three hours.
instructions.10: Store the roasted beans in sealed containers in the fridge.

fah-182.title: Foul Me'alla'a (Skillet Fava Beans)
fah-182.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-182.culturalNotes: The sauce keeps in the fridge for a long time without spoiling. You can serve the beans with bread or raqaq (crispy flatbread).

instructions.1: Soak the fava beans, chickpeas, wheat berries and split fava beans in boiling water overnight.
instructions.2: Drain the water and put the beans in a large pot.
instructions.3: Add the grated carrot and water until it covers the beans by about 6 cm.
instructions.4: Cover the pot and put it over high heat until the water boils.
instructions.5: Lower the heat and leave the beans to cook over low heat until done.
instructions.6: Add half a cup of rice flour and the turmeric and stir well.
instructions.7: Add two tablespoons of ghee, two pieces of basturma, the green pepper and the kahramani beans, and stir over the heat.
instructions.8: Transfer the beans to a tagine, nestle the eggs in the middle and add a spoonful of ghee.
instructions.9: Add a little oil, minced onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, hot chilli, tomato paste, salt, cumin, coriander and chilli, and stir well.
instructions.10: Add the tahini, vinegar, duqqa and boiling water, and stir well until it becomes thick.
instructions.11: Add the beans puréed in the blender, and stir over the heat with a pinch of cumin and salt.
instructions.12: Add the yogurt, duqqa and cooked beans, and stir well.
instructions.13: Add the onion, tomatoes, bell pepper, hot chilli and parsley, and stir well.
instructions.14: Serve the beans hot with the sauce and yogurt.

fah-772.title: Iced Caramel Macchiato
fah-772.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-772.culturalNotes: You can use ground coffee instead of an espresso machine if one isn't available. Brown sugar also works for making caramel syrup at home.

instructions.1: Make the espresso: pull 2 shots using an espresso machine, or mix a tablespoon of ground coffee with half a cup of hot water.
instructions.2: Add the whipped milk: pour a tablespoon of whipped milk into the cup.
instructions.3: Add the syrup: pour a tablespoon of caramel syrup into the cup.
instructions.4: Mix the espresso, whipped milk and caramel syrup together well.
instructions.5: Add ice to the cup as desired.
instructions.6: Add milk as desired.
instructions.7: Top with whipped cream for the finishing touch.
instructions.8: Serve immediately while cold.

fah-773.title: Prickly Pear Ice Cream
fah-773.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-773.culturalNotes: You can add small pieces of fresh prickly pear for a stronger flavour. The ice cream keeps in the freezer for up to a week.

instructions.1: Add 3 cups of prickly pear juice to a bowl.
instructions.2: Add 1 cup of raw whipping cream.
instructions.3: Add ½ cup of icing sugar.
instructions.4: Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla.
instructions.5: Add a drop of yellow food colouring.
instructions.6: Stir the ingredients well until combined.
instructions.7: Put the mixture in a container and cover it.
instructions.8: Place the container in the freezer for at least 4 hours.
instructions.9: After 4 hours, take the container out and check that the consistency has thickened.

fah-774.title: Agameya Ice Cream (Honey-Sesame Fudge)
fah-774.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-774.culturalNotes: You can add other flavours such as strawberry or vanilla to the base ice cream mixture. The ice cream keeps in the freezer for up to a week.

instructions.1: In a bowl, whip the cream well until thick.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and whip together until combined.
instructions.3: Toast the agameya in a pan over low heat with the ghee until golden.
instructions.4: Add the honey, raisins and walnuts and mix well.
instructions.5: Fold the toasted agameya into the ice cream mixture.
instructions.6: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip the scoop in hot water for easier scooping.

fah-775.title: Fruit Ice Cream (Kiwi, Chocolate Banana, Strawberry)
fah-775.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-775.culturalNotes: You can use any favourite fruit, and add other flavours such as vanilla or almond to taste.

instructions.1: Peel the fruit and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the fruit in bags and keep them in the freezer.
instructions.3: Choose your favourite fruit (kiwi, chocolate banana, strawberry).
instructions.4: Blend the fruit with the yogurt and whipping cream in the blender.
instructions.5: Add honey if you want extra sweetness.
instructions.6: Add cocoa if you want a chocolate taste.
instructions.7: Blend the ingredients well until smooth.
instructions.8: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for two to three hours.
instructions.9: Stir the mixture once or twice while freezing for a smoother texture.
instructions.10: Serve the ice cream straight after freezing.

fah-776.title: Budget Fruit Ice Cream
fah-776.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-776.culturalNotes: Different frozen fruits work — strawberry, mango and banana. You can also use Eastern-dessert syrup (sharbat) instead of honey if unavailable.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen fruit, whipping cream, yogurt, lemon juice and cold milk in the blender.
instructions.2: Add honey to taste and blend for 5 minutes until combined.
instructions.3: Add the food colouring if you want a stronger colour.
instructions.4: Pour the mixture into clean, dry containers and cover them.
instructions.5: Freeze the containers for at least 8 hours.
instructions.6: Once frozen, serve the ice cream in cups and garnish as desired.

fah-777.title: Cantaloupe Ice Cream
fah-777.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-777.culturalNotes: You can use any favourite fruit for this ice cream. It keeps in the freezer for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Peel the cantaloupe and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.2: Put the pieces in a bag and freeze until solid.
instructions.3: In a mixing bowl, place the frozen cantaloupe, yogurt milk and white honey.
instructions.4: Add the dissolved pineapple jelly and mix well.
instructions.5: If you like, add a pinch of food colouring and stir for a brighter colour.
instructions.6: Cover the mixture and freeze for at least 30 minutes.
instructions.7: Before serving, blend the mixture again for a smooth texture.
instructions.8: Serve the ice cream in cups or small bowls.

fah-778.title: Kunafa Ice Cream
fah-778.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-778.culturalNotes: Any frozen fruit can replace the mango. The ice cream keeps in the freezer for up to a week.

instructions.1: Blend the frozen mango, milk and whipping cream in the blender until smooth.
instructions.2: Pour the mixture into a container and freeze for 3 hours.
instructions.3: Take the kunafa out of the freezer and cut it into small pieces.
instructions.4: Add half a cup of ghee to the kunafa and mix well.
instructions.5: Heat the oven to its highest setting and toast the kunafa until crisp.
instructions.6: Add two tablespoons of honey to the toasted kunafa and stir well.
instructions.7: Take the mango ice cream out of the freezer and top it with the crisp kunafa.
instructions.8: Return the ice cream to the freezer for another two hours.
instructions.9: Serve the ice cream in cups and enjoy the wonderful taste.

fah-779.title: Lotus Biscoff Ice Cream
fah-779.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-779.culturalNotes: You can add other flavours such as strawberry or vanilla. For the best result, make sure the cream and condensed milk are cold before mixing.

instructions.1: In a bowl, whip the cream well.
instructions.2: Add the sweetened condensed milk and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Add 4 tablespoons of raw whipping cream and mix into the previous mixture.
instructions.4: Add 3 tablespoons of Lotus spread and mix well.
instructions.5: Put the mixture in a container and scatter crushed Lotus biscuits over it.
instructions.6: Cover the container and freeze for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: Before serving, dip the scoop in hot water for easier scooping.

fah-780.title: Oreo Ice Cream Pops
fah-780.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-780.culturalNotes: Serve in plain cups, or dip them in melted chocolate for a crisp outer shell. A spoon works fine if you don't want to use sticks.

fah-780-i3.name: Dessert cream
fah-780-i3.standardAmount: 1½ cups (or 1 tub of eshta with ½ cup milk)

instructions.1: Break the six packets of Oreos into small pieces.
instructions.2: Whip the cream in a bowl for two minutes.
instructions.3: Add the condensed milk and whip for another two minutes.
instructions.4: Fold the broken Oreo pieces into the mixture.
instructions.5: Pour the mixture into ice cream cups.
instructions.6: Freeze the cups for at least 6 hours until set.
instructions.7: Serve as-is or dipped in melted chocolate.

fah-781.title: No-Egg, No-Machine Ice Cream
fah-781.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-781.culturalNotes: You can add other ingredients such as tinned fruit or nuts to taste. The ice cream keeps in the freezer for a long time.

instructions.1: Mix a cup of raw whipping cream with 2½ cups of chilled milk in a bowl and beat for 5 minutes until thick.
instructions.2: Add the whipping cream and beat for a minute.
instructions.3: Add the cup of condensed milk and beat for another minute until combined.
instructions.4: Divide the mixture between 4 airtight containers.
instructions.5: Add 3 tablespoons of caramel sauce to one container and stir well.
instructions.6: Add half a teaspoon of liquid vanilla to another container and stir well.
instructions.7: Add the sachet of black coffee to another container and stir well.
instructions.8: Add 3 tablespoons of chocolate spread and 1 tablespoon of raw cocoa to the last container and stir well.
instructions.9: Freeze the containers for at least 8 hours.
instructions.10: After 8 hours, take the containers out of the freezer and serve the ice cream in cups or bowls.
instructions.11: Garnish the ice cream with caramel sauce and nuts as desired.

fah-782.title: Healthy Budget Strawberry Ice Cream
fah-782.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-782.culturalNotes: You can add a little natural strawberry juice for a stronger flavour. Keeps in the freezer for up to a week.

instructions.1: Mix the chopped strawberries with the sugar, milk and whipping cream in a bowl.
instructions.2: Freeze the mixture for an hour.
instructions.3: Take it out of the freezer and whip it well in the food processor.
instructions.4: Return the mixture to the freezer for another 30 minutes.
instructions.5: Take it out once more and whip again.
instructions.6: Serve in cups or small bowls.

fah-783.title: Homemade Ice Cream in Three Flavours: Vanilla, Caramel & Chocolate
fah-783.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-783.culturalNotes: Any crushed biscuits work. You can also add dried fruit or nuts to boost the flavour.

instructions.1: In a bowl, mix the milk, sugar and cornflour well.
instructions.2: Put the mixture over medium heat and stir until it starts to boil and thickens.
instructions.3: Add the butter and keep stirring until it melts.
instructions.4: Take the mixture off the heat and let it cool slightly.
instructions.5: Add the 3 packets of Dream Whip, a tablespoon of vanilla and a cup of chilled milk. Mix well for 7 minutes.
instructions.6: Transfer the mixture to a bowl and chill in the fridge for two hours until completely cold.
instructions.7: Once chilled, divide the mixture into three parts.
instructions.8: For the vanilla flavour: mix one part well.
instructions.9: For the caramel flavour: add 3 tablespoons of caramel and half a cup of crushed biscuits. Mix well.
instructions.10: For the chocolate flavour: add 2 tablespoons of cocoa, 2 tablespoons of chocolate chips and 3 tablespoons of melted chocolate. Mix well.
instructions.11: Put the flavours in trays and freeze for 4–6 hours until set.
instructions.12: Before serving, let the ice cream soften for 10 minutes, then serve.

fah-784.title: Ice Cream Cake
fah-784.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-784.culturalNotes: You can use different ice cream flavours as you like. The cake keeps in the freezer for up to 3 days.

instructions.1: Make the cake: mix the flour, sugar, baking powder and salt in a bowl.
instructions.2: Add the eggs and vanilla and mix until combined.
instructions.3: Pour the cake batter into a greased, floured tray.
instructions.4: Bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 20 minutes, or until golden.
instructions.5: Take the cake out of the oven and leave it to cool.
instructions.6: Make the vanilla ice cream: mix the vanilla ice cream powder with the chilled milk and whip for 7 minutes.
instructions.7: Make the chocolate ice cream: mix the chocolate ice cream powder with the chilled milk and whip for 7 minutes.
instructions.8: Drizzle a light syrup over the cooled cake.
instructions.9: Spread the chocolate ice cream over the cake evenly.
instructions.10: Spread the vanilla ice cream over the chocolate layer evenly.
instructions.11: Gently shake the tin to level the ice cream.
instructions.12: Freeze the cake for 5–6 hours until set.
instructions.13: Take the cake out and decorate with the ice cream balls and chocolate sauce.

fah-158.title: Artichokes with Béchamel
fah-158.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-158.culturalNotes: Boiled artichokes keep in the freezer for a long time. Serve the dish hot with a green salad.

instructions.1: Wash the artichokes and peel them with a sharp knife, then remove the inner heart with a spoon.
instructions.2: Soak the artichokes in boiling water for 3 minutes, then rinse with cold water if storing.
instructions.3: In a pan over the heat, melt the ghee or oil, add the chopped onion and sauté until golden.
instructions.4: Add the minced meat and stir well, then add the salt, pepper, sugar, cinnamon and seven-spice and stir well.
instructions.5: In a pot over the heat, melt the ghee or butter, add the flour and stir until pale.
instructions.6: Add the warm milk gradually while stirring constantly, then add the salt, pepper, nutmeg, Kiri cheese and cream and stir well — this is the béchamel.
instructions.7: Grease a tagine with ghee or butter, stuff the artichokes with the seasoned meat and arrange them in the tagine.
instructions.8: Pour the béchamel over the artichokes, then top with the eshta and milk mixture.
instructions.9: Place the tagine in a preheated hot oven until the top browns.

fah-159.title: Oil-Free Aubergine & Pepper Salad
fah-159.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-159.culturalNotes: An appetising dish that works on its own or alongside koshari, potatoes and beans. It also makes a good breakfast plate.

instructions.1: Cut the aubergines into medium cubes.
instructions.2: Cut the peppers into large pieces — use hot or sweet peppers as you like.
instructions.3: Prepare a pot of boiling water and add a tablespoon of salt and two tablespoons of vinegar.
instructions.4: Add the aubergine and peppers to the boiling water, cover the pot and leave for 10 minutes.
instructions.5: After 10 minutes, drain the aubergine and peppers in a colander to remove excess water.
instructions.6: Put the aubergine and peppers in a dish, add a little olive oil and chopped fresh coriander.
instructions.7: Toss the ingredients together well.
instructions.8: Add a little vinegar and toss once more.

fah-160.title: Crispy Cauliflower Pané
fah-160.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-160.culturalNotes: Don't press the cauliflower flat when coating it — keep the coating loose so it stays crunchy. The coated cauliflower can be frozen before frying and used later.

instructions.1: Wash the cauliflower well and cut it into small florets.
instructions.2: Bring a pot of water to the boil, then add a tablespoon of salt and a teaspoon of cumin.
instructions.3: Drop the cauliflower into the boiling water and blanch briefly, then drain and transfer to cold water to stop the cooking.
instructions.4: Mix the flour, cornflour and spices (salt, pepper, cumin, paprika, garlic powder, baking powder) in a bowl.
instructions.5: Add the beaten eggs, minced garlic and parsley to half of the dry mixture, then add water gradually while stirring until the consistency is like pancake batter.
instructions.6: Dip the cauliflower florets in the wet batter, then coat them in the dry mixture.
instructions.7: Fry the cauliflower in hot oil over medium heat until golden and crisp.
instructions.8: Serve the cauliflower pané on a bed of chopped parsley.

fah-161.title: Boiled & Pickled Potatoes
fah-161.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-161.culturalNotes: Boiled potatoes keep in the fridge and can be used in different recipes.

instructions.1: Boil the potatoes in salted water until firm-tender.
instructions.2: Peel the potatoes and cut them into cubes.
instructions.3: Mix the duqqa with the oil and turmeric.
instructions.4: Add the duqqa mixture to the cubed potatoes and toss well.
instructions.5: Add the dill and parsley and toss together.
instructions.6: Serve in the serving dish.

fah-162.title: Crispy Potato Cubes
fah-162.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-162.culturalNotes: Serve the fried potatoes as a snack or as part of a main meal. Fresh herbs like parsley or coriander add flavour.

instructions.1: Peel the potatoes and cut them into small cubes.
instructions.2: Rinse the cubes well in cold water.
instructions.3: Heat the oil in a frying pan over medium heat.
instructions.4: Add the potato cubes to the hot oil and stir well.
instructions.5: Add the salt, black pepper and sugar and stir together.
instructions.6: Keep frying until the potatoes are golden and crisp.
instructions.7: Drain the fried potatoes on absorbent paper.

fah-163.title: Pickled Cucumber & Carrots
fah-163.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-163.culturalNotes: Always use a clean, dry spoon when serving pickles to avoid scum forming. The pickles keep in the fridge for up to two weeks.

instructions.1: Wash the cucumbers and carrots well and slice them thinly.
instructions.2: Place them in a bowl with the pepper slices and celery.
instructions.3: Make the brine: boil a litre of water and add 4 tablespoons of salt, a tablespoon of sugar, a teaspoon of turmeric and a quarter cup of vinegar. Stir well.
instructions.4: Pour the brine over the cucumbers and carrots in the bowl.
instructions.5: Add the bay leaves, nigella seeds, garlic, hot chilli, coriander and cumin.
instructions.6: Cover the bowl well and leave for at least 6 hours.
instructions.7: After 6 hours the cucumber is ready to eat; leave the carrots for another day or two.
instructions.8: Add a few drops of oil on top of the pickle to preserve it.

fah-164.title: Spinach with Orzo
fah-164.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-164.culturalNotes: Serve the spinach with orzo alongside rice with vermicelli and browned meat. Leftovers keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat a pot over the heat and add a tablespoon of ghee.
instructions.2: Add the bay leaf, mastic, cardamom pod and black pepper.
instructions.3: Add the carrot, onion and tomatoes and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the beef shank and stir until browned and sealed.
instructions.5: Add the boiling water, salt and sugar, then cover the pot and leave over low heat until the meat is cooked.
instructions.6: In another pot, heat the ghee and oil, add the orzo and stir until golden.
instructions.7: Add the chopped tomatoes, stock cube, salt and sugar, stir together and leave the tomatoes to thicken.
instructions.8: Add the spinach and coriander and stir well until it thickens.
instructions.9: Add the orzo to the spinach, stir together, then cover the pot and leave over low heat for 15 minutes.
instructions.10: In a small pot, heat two tablespoons of oil and a spoonful of ghee, add the vermicelli and stir until golden.
instructions.11: Add the rice and stir with the vermicelli until combined.
instructions.12: Add the boiling water and salt, cover the pot and leave the rice to absorb.
instructions.13: Once absorbed, give the rice a light stir, then cover and leave over low heat until cooked.
instructions.14: In another pot, heat a little oil and ghee, add the meat and stir until browned.
instructions.15: Add the salt, black pepper and parsley, and stir until the meat is cooked.

fah-165.title: Pickled Tomatoes
fah-165.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-165.culturalNotes: Pickled tomatoes go well with koshari or any dish you like.

instructions.1: Wash the tomatoes well.
instructions.2: Cut the tomatoes into thin slices, keeping the base attached.
instructions.3: Stuff the tadbeela between each slice.
instructions.4: Put the tomatoes in a container and cover.
instructions.5: Keep the tomatoes in the fridge for up to 3 months.

fah-166.title: Pickled Peppers
fah-166.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-166.culturalNotes: Pickled peppers keep in the fridge for two weeks. Serve them with beans, ta'ameya, potatoes, msaqqa'a and koshari — they add wonderful flavour.

instructions.1: Cut the peppers into small pieces, 2–3 cm.
instructions.2: Add 4 cups of water to a pot and place it over the heat.
instructions.3: Add 2 tablespoons of salt to the water.
instructions.4: Add the coriander, cumin and minced garlic to the water.
instructions.5: Stir well until the salt dissolves.
instructions.6: Add the pepper pieces to the boiling water and boil for 2–3 minutes.
instructions.7: Add the vinegar to the water and take the pot off the heat.
instructions.8: Leave the peppers to cool.
instructions.9: Pack the peppers into a container and keep in the fridge.
instructions.10: Add a little oil on top if you like.

fah-167.title: Baladi Mixed Pickles
fah-167.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-167.culturalNotes: Make sure the jars are thoroughly clean before use. A spoonful of pickling spice in the brine improves the flavour.

fah-167-i7.name: vinegar
fah-167-i7.standardAmount: ½ cup per litre of water

fah-167-i8.name: Lemon juice
fah-167-i8.standardAmount: ¼ cup per litre of water

instructions.1: Wash the lemons well and soak them in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Peel the carrots, cut them into small pieces and soak in boiling water for 10 minutes.
instructions.3: Remove the leaves from the cauliflower, cut it into small florets and soak in boiling water with half a teaspoon of cumin for 10 minutes.
instructions.4: Wash the cucumbers, cut into small pieces and soak in boiling water.
instructions.5: Slice the green and jalapeño peppers and soak them in boiling water.
instructions.6: Drain all the vegetables and pack them into clean jars.
instructions.7: Make the brine by mixing the water, salt, vinegar, lemon juice, nigella seeds, garlic, turmeric and harissa.
instructions.8: Pour the brine over the vegetables in the jars until completely covered.
instructions.9: Add two tablespoons of oil on top of each jar to keep the air out.
instructions.10: Seal the jars well and leave for 3 days before using.

fah-168.title: Mixed Vegetable Pickles
fah-168.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-168.culturalNotes: Use clean, sterilised jars and cover the pickles well with brine to prevent spoilage. Leftover duqqa keeps in the freezer for later.

instructions.1: Make the duqqa: put the hot and sweet red peppers, vinegar, lemon juice, salt, cumin and coriander in the food processor and grind well.
instructions.2: Make the brine: mix 4 cups of boiled, cooled water, a quarter cup of lemon juice, a quarter cup of vinegar, a teaspoon of sugar and 4 tablespoons of salt.
instructions.3: For the jalapeños: put a quarter cup of sugar, two tablespoons of salt, a quarter cup of vinegar, citric acid and the garlic cloves in boiling water, add the jalapeños, stir once, then lift out and cover until cool.
instructions.4: For the cauliflower: cut it into small florets, put in boiling water, cover for 10 minutes, then lift into a clean jar and add the grated beetroot, two spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.5: For the aubergines: put a quarter cup of vinegar, two tablespoons of salt and a spoonful of sugar in boiling water, add the aubergines in batches, lift out after 10 minutes and pack into a jar with pepper slices, two spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.6: For the lemons: mix the yellow lemons, nigella seeds, turmeric, duqqa and brine in a clean jar.
instructions.7: For the onions: put the onions in boiling water with a quarter cup of vinegar and a tablespoon of salt, lift out after 5 minutes and pack into a jar with 3 spoonfuls of duqqa and the brine.
instructions.8: For the cabbage: put the cabbage in boiling water, then pack into a clean jar with the grated beetroot, duqqa and brine.
instructions.9: For the carrots: cut them into the desired shape, put in boiling water, lift out and pack into a jar with garlic cloves, fennel seeds, sugar, duqqa and brine.

fah-169.title: Quick Mixed Pickles
fah-169.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-169.culturalNotes: You can add celery and nigella seeds for better flavour. Make sure the jars are sealed tightly for good-quality pickles.

instructions.1: Boil water and pour it over the cauliflower; leave it to soak for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Soak the cauliflower in boiling water for 10 minutes, covered, to keep the heat in.
instructions.3: Put the red peppers, green peppers, cucumbers and carrots in a bowl and toss together.
instructions.4: Add turnips too if you have them.
instructions.5: Make the red duqqa: crush 4 garlic cloves with hot red peppers.
instructions.6: Add the salt to the hot water and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Add the dried coriander and cumin to the brine.
instructions.8: Add the celery and nigella seeds if you like.
instructions.9: Pour the hot brine over the vegetables in the jars.
instructions.10: Make sure the vegetables are completely covered by the brine.
instructions.11: Seal the jars tightly and leave for 3 days before opening.

fah-170.title: No-Oil Msaqqa'a (Aubergine Bake)
fah-170.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-170.culturalNotes: Serve the msaqqa'a with white rice or Arabic bread. It keeps in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Heat a frying pan over medium heat and add the hot and sweet peppers cut into thin strips.
instructions.2: Add the chopped onion and stir until golden.
instructions.3: Add the minced garlic and stir until golden.
instructions.4: Add the tomato juice and tomato paste and stir together.
instructions.5: Add the salt, coriander, cumin, sugar and black pepper and stir well.
instructions.6: Add the stock cube and stir until dissolved.
instructions.7: Add the boiling water and leave until it boils and thickens.
instructions.8: Slice the aubergine and potatoes into rounds and arrange them in the baking tray.
instructions.9: Pour the sauce over the aubergine and potatoes.
instructions.10: Cover the tray and put it in the oven on high heat for an hour and a quarter.
instructions.11: After an hour and a quarter, take the tray out, remove the cover and put it under the grill for a few minutes until golden.
instructions.12: Take the msaqqa'a out of the oven and serve hot.

fah-171.title: Quick & Light Msaqqa'a
fah-171.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-171.culturalNotes: Serve the msaqqa'a hot or cold. Add more tomatoes to taste for a saucier dish.

instructions.1: Slice the aubergine lengthways, sprinkle with salt and leave in a colander for 10 minutes.
instructions.2: Cut the potatoes into cubes and fry until golden.
instructions.3: Cut the bell peppers into thin strips and prepare the hot chilli to taste.
instructions.4: In a bowl, sauté the onions cut into wedges in two tablespoons of oil until golden.
instructions.5: Add the minced garlic and minced meat and stir until the meat changes colour.
instructions.6: Add the bell peppers and hot chilli and stir for a minute.
instructions.7: Add the tomato juice, cumin, salt, pepper, seven-spice and sugar, and leave the mixture to boil.
instructions.8: In a tagine, lay a layer of the vegetable and meat mixture, then a layer of fried potatoes, then a layer of fried aubergine.
instructions.9: Repeat the layers until the ingredients are used up.
instructions.10: Cover the tagine and bake in a preheated oven at 180°C for 30 minutes.

fah-314.title: Baladi Mish (Fermented Cheese)
fah-314.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-314.culturalNotes: You can use fresh milk instead of laban rayeb if you don't have any. Mish keeps in the fridge and is served cold.

instructions.1: Bring a wire sieve and place the laban rayeb (fermented milk) in it.
instructions.2: Add a teaspoon of salt to the laban rayeb and stir well.
instructions.3: Add a teaspoon of red pepper and the ground fenugreek and stir well.
instructions.4: Add the aged peppers and hot dried chilli to taste and stir well.
instructions.5: Cover the mixture and leave it for 24 hours.
instructions.6: After 24 hours, add the whey and qareesh cheese to the mixture and stir well.
instructions.7: Cover the mixture and leave it for two to three weeks.

fah-315.title: Homemade Qareesh Cheese
fah-315.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-315.culturalNotes: Use good, fresh milk for the best result. Qareesh cheese keeps in the fridge for a long time without spoiling.

instructions.1: Prepare the milk: warm 5 kg of milk over low heat for just one minute in winter; in summer it doesn't need warming.
instructions.2: Set the milk: pour the milk into a pot, cover it with a clean cloth and leave it in the (unlit) oven for two days in winter or one day in summer. Do not shake or move the pot.
instructions.3: Take the cream off: after the set time, separate the cream from the cheese — the milk will have turned into a single mass.
instructions.4: Drain the cheese: put the cheese on a mat or in a sieve to drain the liquid. Add salt to taste and stir the cheese well.
instructions.5: Storage: once drained, put the cheese in a container and cover it with its own whey plus two tablespoons of salt per litre of whey. Add the chilli pod too. Keep the cheese in the fridge.
instructions.6: Use the qareesh cheese in different dishes or eat it as it is.

fah-316.title: Cream Cheese from Qareesh Cheese
fah-316.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-316.culturalNotes: Qareesh cheese makes an easy, quick cream cheese. Add your favourite flavours — basturma, olives, thyme, romy cheese or hot pepper. Qareesh is rich in protein and calcium, perfect with toast or in school sandwiches.

instructions.1: Add the qareesh cheese and milk to the blender.
instructions.2: Blend well until the consistency is creamy.
instructions.3: For a richer cheese, add 2 tablespoons of oil.
instructions.4: Add your favourite flavours — basturma, olives, thyme, romy cheese or hot pepper — then blend again.
instructions.5: Blend once more until the mixture is uniform.
instructions.6: For the plain cheese, add a pinch of nigella seeds and 2 teaspoons of olive oil.
instructions.7: Serve the cream cheese with toasted bread or in school sandwiches.

fah-317.title: Goulash Rolls with Kofta
fah-317.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-317.culturalNotes: The rolls work as a light meal or summer sandwiches. They keep in the fridge for two days.

instructions.1: Mix the Knorr kofta seasoning with the minced meat and grated onion.
instructions.2: Knead the kofta well until combined.
instructions.3: Make the brushing mixture: mix half a cup of melted butter with a tub of yogurt and a teaspoon of baking powder.
instructions.4: Take a phyllo sheet and brush it with the mixture, then lay two more sheets on top, brushing each one.
instructions.5: Take a portion of the kofta, place it at the edge of the phyllo and roll it up evenly.
instructions.6: Repeat until all the phyllo sheets are used.
instructions.7: Place the rolls in a tray greased with ghee or oil.
instructions.8: Brush the tops of the rolls with ghee or oil before baking.
instructions.9: Heat the oven to 180°C and put the tray on the middle rack.
instructions.10: Bake the rolls until golden, about 20 minutes.
instructions.11: Take the rolls out of the oven and serve hot with tahini sauce and fried potato pickles.

fah-318.title: Homemade Peanut Butter
fah-318.chapter: Chapter 10: Fatma Abu Haty Channel Recipes
fah-318.culturalNotes: The butter keeps in a jar in the fridge for up to a month. Serve with bread or in sandwiches.

instructions.1: Heat the oven to 170°C.
instructions.2: Spread the peanuts on a baking tray and roast until golden.
instructions.3: Leave the peanuts to cool slightly, then grind them in the blender until smooth.
instructions.4: Add the honey, oil and salt and blend until combined.
instructions.5: Bake the mixture for 10 minutes at 170°C.
instructions.6: Put the peanut butter in a clean, dry jar.
